title: git-vouch design and v1 implementation
description: git-vouch: kernel identity without GPG. Python 3.9+ stdlib-only single-file CLI; git SSH signing and ssh-keygen -Y do all crypto; registry git repo of signed JSON-LD records (people, tiers, endorsements, revocations); git-vouch checks trust rules and generates allowed_signers and revocation files. Spec: DESIGN.md (revised 2026-10-21, renamed from lf-did 2026-10-22). March 2026 lf-did docs kept for history only.
